steps.label: tabs-before
steps.js: () => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')).map(t => { const r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); const st = getComputedStyle(t); const p = t.closest('[style*="display"]'); return { label: t.getAttribute('aria-label'), x: Math.round(r.x), y: Math.round(r.y), w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height), display: st.display, visibility: st.visibility, opacity: st.opacity, color: getComputedStyle(t).color, parentDisplay: p ? getComputedStyle(p).display : null, inExplorePanel: !!t.closest('div[class*="css-view"]') }; })

steps.label: tabs-after
steps.js: () => ({ tabs: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')).map(t => { const r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); const st = getComputedStyle(t); return { label: t.getAttribute('aria-label'), y: Math.round(r.y), w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height), display: st.display, color: getComputedStyle(t).color }; }), body: document.body.innerText.slice(0, 220) })
